verdict.rationale: USCIS's Torch developer platform offers keyed programmatic APIs, so limited headless automation is possible. These cover only case status and FOIA request creation and status. A sandbox exists for testing, but production keys require passing a demo. Filing is account-only through myUSCIS with no filing API, and the public case-status host bot-walls keyless agents. Missing for 10: headless or API access to core filing, payment and account functions; any CI-specific guidance or tooling; self-serve key access without demo approval; independent or hands-on corroboration that the APIs work in automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Provides case status information to USCIS customers and their representatives who require regular access to case status information.
This API allows consumers to create a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) or Privacy Act (PA) request
Gain Access and develop in our Sandbox environment to send test data.
Pass the demo and receive production keys to launch your application.
There is no filing API; myUSCIS is the only online filing rail.
